subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should a configured but unavailable Ollama SecretRef take precedence over and block ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` fallback, with provider-specific normalization and failure callbacks exposed through the shared plugin SDK helper?
rationale: The patch and proof establish that the proposed behavior works, but only maintainers can approve the compatibility policy and permanent public SDK shape.

options.title: Approve fail-closed contract
options.body: Keep the patch so configured Ollama SecretRefs must resolve or fail and the shared helper exposes the two optional provider hooks.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep env SecretRef resolution but revise unavailable configured refs to retain current ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` fallback and avoid the failure-callback contract.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the patch so configured Ollama SecretRefs must resolve or fail and the shared helper exposes the two optional provider hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest combined history signal covers both the shared SecretRef helper and subsequent Ollama web-search and plugin SDK maintenance.
